_meta.purpose: Intelligence product PRD — AI substrate authority after Foundry retirement per ADR-0335; covers provider routing, guardrails, eval, attribution, credential resolution, audit tap, assist-draft, and context-aware retrieval for later cloud-service integration.

acceptance_criteria.given: provider route candidates with different credential modes, capabilities, tenants, audiences, and stable priorities
acceptance_criteria.when: a dispatch request is routed
acceptance_criteria.then: the selected provider satisfies tenant, modality, BYOK, audience, and evidence constraints

acceptance_criteria.given: high-risk or unsafe content categories
acceptance_criteria.when: the guardrail stack evaluates the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the stack fails closed with a stable refusal reason and audit-safe category metadata

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence dispatch, credential, guardrail, or provider event with audit envelope v2 metadata and opaque evidence refs
acceptance_criteria.when: the audit-tap usecase emits the event through an injected audit-chain emitter port
acceptance_criteria.then: the usecase validates tenant/trace/HLC/sustainability metadata, rejects raw prompt/output/secret material, preserves idempotency semantics, and accepts only matching Merkle/signature seal refs

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence guardrail request with classifier findings, policy decision evidence, tenant/principal/surface context, and opaque content refs
acceptance_criteria.when: the guardrails usecase evaluates the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the usecase validates metadata before side effects, enforces policy drift/surface denials, preserves idempotent receipts, fails closed on missing or high-risk classifier output, and records metadata-only audit events without raw prompt/output/credential material

acceptance_criteria.given: opaque query refs, tenant-scoped retrieval candidates, freshness floors, allowed context source kinds, policy evidence, and audience/data-class boundaries
acceptance_criteria.when: the context-aware retrieval kernel plans context for an Intelligence request
acceptance_criteria.then: the kernel validates metadata-only refs, filters cross-tenant/stale/unsupported candidates, blocks sensitive context for external audiences, sorts eligible context deterministically, and returns only opaque resource/evidence refs without raw query or document text

acceptance_criteria.given: a context-aware retrieval request with principal, surface, policy decision evidence, retrieval index snapshot evidence, opaque query refs, allowed source kinds, freshness floors, and candidate metadata
acceptance_criteria.when: the context-aware retrieval domain validates and plans retrieval
acceptance_criteria.then: the domain rejects invalid metadata, policy tenant/principal drift, unauthorized surfaces/source kinds, excessive item caps, weak freshness floors, and sensitive external context before returning only metadata-only kernel plans or fail-closed denials

acceptance_criteria.given: a context-aware retrieval usecase request with idempotency key, domain retrieval request, policy evidence, trace refs, and opaque candidate metadata
acceptance_criteria.when: the usecase plans context retrieval
acceptance_criteria.then: the usecase validates metadata before audit side effects, preserves idempotent receipts and conflict denials, records metadata-only request/planned/denied audit events, delegates to the policy-bound domain layer, and never returns raw query/document/model text

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence eval set with golden, adversarial, linguistic, regression, or safety case metadata, opaque dataset/model/evaluator evidence refs, and pass/safety thresholds
acceptance_criteria.when: the eval kernel scores the eval set
acceptance_criteria.then: the kernel validates metadata-only refs, requires configured golden/adversarial/linguistic coverage, computes deterministic pass and safety-violation rates, fails closed on threshold or safety violations, and never carries raw prompt/output/secret material

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence eval set request with tenant, principal, surface, policy decision evidence, allowed model refs, dataset snapshot refs, case kinds, case-count bounds, and threshold floors
acceptance_criteria.when: the eval domain evaluates the platform request
acceptance_criteria.then: the domain rejects invalid metadata, policy tenant/principal/evidence drift, unauthorized surfaces/models/datasets/case kinds, weak thresholds, and case-count bound violations before returning only metadata-only eval reports or fail-closed denials

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence eval usecase request with an idempotency key, domain eval set request, request/trace/policy evidence refs, and metadata-only eval set records
acceptance_criteria.when: the eval usecase evaluates the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the usecase rejects invalid metadata before audit side effects, preserves idempotent replay and conflict denials, records metadata-only requested/evaluated/denied/conflict audit events, delegates to the policy-bound eval domain, and never carries raw prompt/output/secret material

acceptance_criteria.given: an Intelligence eval adapter request with an idempotency key, policy-bound domain eval request, evaluated usecase receipt, opaque credential/audit/runner refs, and metadata-only platform records

acceptance_criteria.given: an assist-draft kernel request with tenant/principal/context, builder surface, draft kind, invocation mode, review gate, prompt/context/output-contract refs, consent/budget/policy/model-route/guardrail evidence, data-class metadata, and requested draft actions
acceptance_criteria.when: the kernel plans draft assistance for no-code builders
acceptance_criteria.then: it validates metadata-only refs, requires consent/budget/policy/model/guardrail provenance, refuses hidden or shadow invocations, auto-apply and activation actions, unsupported surface-kind pairs, and sensitive external drafts, returns deterministic advisory draft plan refs only, and performs no model call, provider dispatch, prompt rendering, builder mutation, network, or durable side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: an assist-draft domain request with tenant/principal policy decision metadata, brand surface ref, locale, prompt-context refs, cost-floor disclosure ref, builder capability scope, and a metadata-only kernel assist-draft request
acceptance_criteria.when: the domain layer plans no-code builder draft assistance under tenant policy
acceptance_criteria.then: it validates safe metadata refs, enforces tenant/principal/policy binding, AI-assist enablement, explicit automation policy, no auto-apply or activation, allowed builder surface, draft kind, audience, data classes, requested actions, locale, and prompt-context caps, preserves user locale and cost-floor disclosure refs, maps kernel denials with policy evidence, emits redaction-safe refusal banners, and performs no prompt rendering, model call, provider dispatch, builder mutation, network, durable audit-chain write, or durable side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: an assist-draft usecase input with an idempotency key and a policy-bound assist-draft domain request

acceptance_criteria.then: it validates metadata-only refs before side effects, records in-memory metadata-only requested/planned/denied/conflict audit events, returns deterministic idempotent receipts, detects idempotency conflicts without replacing the original receipt, maps domain and kernel denials with refusal banners and policy evidence, preserves cost-floor disclosure and locale metadata, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret-shaped input without echo, and performs no prompt rendering, model call, provider dispatch, builder mutation, network, durable idempotency storage, durable audit-chain write, queue processing, or durable side effect

acceptance_criteria.then: it validates HTTPS/non-local endpoint and opaque refs, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret material, requires a planned usecase receipt bound to the domain request, builds a metadata-only assist-draft executor envelope with prompt/context/builder/cost/action/evidence refs, maps accepted/queued/completed/error statuses distinctly, and performs no network, prompt rendering, model/provider call, builder mutation, durable idempotency, durable audit-chain write, queue processing, or durable side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: an assist-draft REST POST request carrying request id, tenant, idempotency, trace, authenticated principal, authorization decision metadata, and a policy-bound assist-draft domain request body
acceptance_criteria.when: the source-level API/REST boundary accepts an advisory assist-draft request for later cloud integration
acceptance_criteria.then: it validates tenant/principal/authorization/policy/request binding before side effects, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret material with structured redaction-safe errors, preserves in-memory idempotent replay and conflict semantics, delegates planned requests to the metadata-only usecase and executor adapter seam, maps accepted/queued/completed and executor error outcomes to stable HTTP-shaped statuses, exposes a framework-free POST route contract, and performs no HTTP serving, prompt rendering, model/provider call, builder mutation, serialization framework work, network execution, durable idempotency storage, durable audit-chain write, queue processing, or durable side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: an assist-draft worker job with lease metadata, attempt bounds, not-before scheduling metadata, an assist-draft usecase input, and a configured metadata-only assist-draft executor adapter
acceptance_criteria.when: the worker processes one source-level job attempt for later cloud integration
acceptance_criteria.then: the worker validates job and assist-draft metadata before side effects, defers not-before jobs without usecase or adapter calls, runs the assist-draft usecase, dispatches planned receipts through the adapter, records metadata-only worker events, computes deterministic retry, exhausted, and nonretry receipts for executor outcomes, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret-shaped metadata without echo, and performs no durable queue processing, HTTP serving, prompt rendering, model/provider call, builder mutation, network execution, durable idempotency storage, durable audit-chain write, or cloud runtime side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: a credential resolver usecase handle request with tenant, provider, audience, parsed OpenBao or platform-default secret reference metadata, request evidence, and a configured metadata-only credential sidecar adapter

acceptance_criteria.given: an audit-tap usecase record request with audit envelope v2 metadata, opaque evidence/resource refs, canonical fingerprint, and a configured metadata-only audit-chain adapter
acceptance_criteria.when: the adapter emits to the future audit-chain sidecar seam for later cloud integration
acceptance_criteria.then: it validates sidecar config and request/status metadata before envelope side effects, builds a metadata-only audit-chain request envelope with writer/Merkle/signature/outbox/audience refs, maps sealed/denied/rate-limited/error/auth/invalid/timeout outcomes to seal receipts or sanitized failures, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret/key-shaped metadata without echo, and performs no Ed25519 signing, Merkle construction, network execution, queue processing, durable audit-chain write, filesystem access, or cloud runtime side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: an audit-tap worker job with lease metadata, attempt bounds, not-before scheduling metadata, audit-event envelope v2 input, and a configured metadata-only audit-chain adapter
acceptance_criteria.when: the worker processes one source-level audit-tap job attempt for later cloud integration
acceptance_criteria.then: the worker validates job and audit-event metadata before side effects, defers not-before jobs without usecase or adapter calls, runs the audit-tap usecase through the adapter seam, records metadata-only worker events, maps sealed receipts and audit-chain denied/invalid/retryable outcomes to deterministic receipts, computes capped retry and exhaustion metadata, rejects raw prompt/output/document/secret/key-shaped metadata without echo, and performs no durable queue processing, Ed25519 signing, Merkle construction, network execution, filesystem access, durable audit-chain write, or cloud runtime side effect

acceptance_criteria.given: a model-routing usecase request with tenant-scoped route metadata, principal, trace, policy decision, route registry snapshot evidence, idempotency key, and a provider catalog snapshot
acceptance_criteria.when: the usecase selects or denies a route for later provider dispatch integration
acceptance_criteria.then: it validates metadata before cache or audit side effects, preserves in-memory idempotent replay and conflict denial semantics, delegates route selection to the domain/kernel layers, records metadata-only route requested/selected/denied audit events, rejects raw prompt/output/secret-shaped refs without echo, and performs no provider call, credential resolution, network execution, durable idempotency storage, durable audit-chain write, queue processing, or cloud runtime side effect

implementation_status.claim_policy: Only claim implemented model-routing kernel/domain/usecase, assist-draft kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/api/rest/worker, guardrail kernel/domain/usecase, context-aware retrieval kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/worker, eval kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/worker, attribution kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/worker, dispatch, provider-envelope, credential-resolver domain/usecase/adapter, and audit-tap usecase/adapter/worker foundations with fresh cargo/oya evidence; assist-draft durable queue/runtime, HTTP serving, serialization framework integration, credential sidecar runtime/OpenBao I/O/raw secret material, audit-chain sidecar runtime/Ed25519 signing/Merkle construction/durable audit emission/durable queue processing/cloud runtime deployment, model-routing adapter/api/rest/grpc/worker runtime, broader provider adapters, eval binary/queue/runtime, retrieval runtime/vector-store/embedding/ontology-KG/document-fetch execution, attribution runtime, queue execution, citation text rendering, and cloud deployment claims remain non-claims until implemented and gated.

user_decisions: 2026-05-24: vertical enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat single-concern domain crate

external_rejected.name: vendor ERP/CRM platform SDKs
external_rejected.reason: no proprietary platform lock-in; flat single-concern crates only

packs.notes: Korea localization pack overlay applies when the vertical activates KR scope

decision_log.decision: intelligence enters the microservice set as a flat single-concern foundation; runtime/provider/production remain non-claims.

goals.scalability: Independent horizontal scaling per ADR-0348 (autosharding/auto-rebalance); tenant- and cell-scoped writes with no shared mutable global state. Foundation scope: metadata-only, no measured scaling evidence.
goals.security: Default-deny tenant isolation via Cedar (ADR-0243) and tenant-as-scope (ADR-0244); no raw credential/PII/secret bytes in the domain. Foundation scope: no runtime authentication.
goals.performance: Per-manifest SLO and capacity targets (ADR-0340) required before any GA claim; async-first eventing on Pulsar. Foundation scope: no measured SLO.
goals.efficiency: FinOps cost attribution (ADR-0344) and flat single-concern crates (ADR-0131/0132) that avoid platform bloat. Foundation scope: no runtime cost telemetry.
goals.reliability: Idempotent metadata operations and rollback-first promotion. Foundation scope: no DR drill evidence.

risks.risk: foundation scope mistaken for runtime readiness

competitive.note: parity metadata only; no proprietary platform lock-in
